values.note: ReserveAmerica, up to 9 months ahead, same day included; DEC's 2026 summary sets a 1-night reservation minimum here. A permit runs at most 14 nights, and from July 1 through Labor Day only 14 cumulative nights are allowed at any campground. Register by 9 pm on the first night or the site is re-rented.

summary: Confirmed $20 + $5 non-resident (DEC 2026 summary), 2027 season May 14-Oct 10 (DEC 2026: May 15-Oct 12), ReserveAmerica 9-month window, 14-night max (booking was only inherited; now verified). Added 1-night minimum (DEC summary), 218 sites to 40 ft, no electric, showers, flush toilets, dump. ReserveAmerica tags no site 'Near Water', but AWH's firsthand note (multiple waterfront sites) stands; the campground is on the north and west shores of Meacham Lake. AWH note unchanged. Not stated: water/sewer at sites, pull-throughs.
